overview:
Studying Dentistry in Spain for Indian students is an opportunity to get a European dental qualification, develop clinical skills, and gain international academic exposure. Spanish universities provide undergraduate degrees in dentistry, called Grado en Odontología. These programs generally take five years to complete and are worth 300 ECTS credits.

Students can investigate public and private universities, clinical training opportunities and selected Dentistry programs in Spain taught in English . But the language of instruction is especially important: many dentistry degrees in Spain are taught mostly in Spanish or a regional language and clinical placements require good communication with patients.

faq.question: How many years are required to study Dentistry in Spain?
faq.answer: The normal undergraduate Dentistry degree in Spain lasts for five years and consists of 300 ECTS credits. Universitat de Barcelona +Q2. Can Indian students pursue Dentistry in Spain in English? Yes, some universities have English language pathways or international cohorts. But many programs are conducted mostly in Spanish or a regional language. Students should also confirm the language requirements for clinical training.

faq.question: How much does Dentistry in Spain cost for Indian students?
faq.answer: Public universities charge tuition of €1,000–€5,000 per year, while private programs can cost €12,000–€25,000 or more. These are indicative estimates, please check the current fee schedule of the chosen university.

faq.question: After finishing Dentistry in Spain, can I practice in India?
faq.answer: Not by default . Before choosing a program, check the current requirements for recognition of foreign dental qualifications, screening examinations and registration in India.

faq.question: Do Indian students need NEET to study Dentistry in Spain?
faq.answer: For Indian students who want to study dentistry abroad and then practice in India, the NEET and other eligibility requirements are important to consider. Please check the latest applicable Indian regulations with the relevant regulator before admission. Please check the entry requirements of the Spanish University separately.
